card.name: End of electrolyte and antipsychotic drug phrases
card.fires_on: The last piece of "electrolyte" in "fluid and electrolyte" warnings, and the word "drugs" in "Atypical antipsychotic drugs". Also seen at the end of a compound word such as "reductase" or "web site".
